title: 第10章  楚枫：她是我的女人！
content_zh:
那是一位白发苍苍的老者，身着一件绣着太极图案的青袍，面容红润，眼神深邃，周身散发着淡淡的元婴之力。
王澶感受着体内那股前所未有的强大力量，嘴角忍不住上扬，仰头大笑起来。
哈哈哈……
“我成了，从今日起，我王澶便是青山城的天！”
门外天光倾泻而入，却也将庭院中的景象照得一清二楚。
王天福正一动不动地躺在地上，早已生机全无。
王澶瞳孔骤缩，连呼吸都停滞了。
他踉跄一步，伸出的手指微微颤抖。
“这、这是怎么回事……”
他喉头滚动，猛地提气，吼声震得梁上灰尘簌簌落下。
“谁杀了天福！”
早已跪在院中的王莹，此刻已是泪流满面。
“爷爷，楚枫灭了赵家满门，他还联手子书禾那个贱人，昨夜潜入府中袭杀了父亲。
您一定要为孙女做主，为父亲报仇啊！”
“什么——”
王澶须发皆张，老脸因愤怒而扭曲。
“好一对狗男女，我王澶若不将你们剁碎了喂狗，祭奠我儿在天之灵，誓不为人！”
就在这时，一直垂首立在侧旁的王天寿上前一步。
“父亲，方才有人亲眼看见楚枫与子书禾，往家族豢养妖兽的地牢方向去了。”
王澶猛地转头，赤红的目光看向地牢所在方位。

“随我去地牢！”
地牢外，几位老者正围在子书禾身边，苦口婆心的劝着。
“留得青山在，不怕没柴烧，您还是先离开城主府，暂避风头吧。”
“没错，只要日后您突破到元婴境，自然能够将城主之位夺回来。”
“王澶现在杀红了眼，我们根本拦不住他，您再不走就来不及了！”
他们都是忠于城主王云山之人，从子书禾口中知道了王天福因何而死之后，他们顿时都慌了。
如今王澶已经突破到了元婴境，他们就算是一起上，也绝对不可能是王澶的对手。
子书禾站在原地，目光落在地牢的大门上，心中五味杂陈。
原本她是不信楚枫能够驯服天煞鬼虎的，可此刻，她的心中竟然产生了一丝期盼。
或许，他真的能行呢。
想到这里，子书禾缓缓摇了摇头，语气坚定地说道。
“我不走。”
“什么？”
几位长老都是一惊，脸上满是不解。
“王澶马上就要来了，他不会放过您的！”
子书禾没有解释，只是紧紧握着手中的城主令，目光依旧停留在地牢大门上。
她不知道自己为什么会选择相信楚枫，只是心中有一种感觉。
今日若是逃了，便永远都回不来了。
就在这时，远处传来一阵急促的脚步声。
众人转头望去，只见王澶带着大批王家子弟和长老，杀气腾腾地冲了过来。

“今天，谁都别想走！”
王澶停下脚步，冰冷的目光扫过在场的所有人，最后落在子书禾身上。
“楚枫呢，他躲哪去了？”
子书禾握紧手中的城主令，上前一步冷声道。
“王澶，你想要干什么？”
王澶嗤笑一声，眼神中满是不屑。
“老夫已经突破到元婴境，放眼整个青山城，无人是我的对手。
你以为拿着一块破令牌，还能号令老夫吗？”
他的目光扫过护在子书禾身边的几位长老，语气带着一丝威胁。
“从今往后，这城主之位便由我来做，谁赞成，谁反对？”
几位长老脸色变幻不定，就在这时，五长老站了出来。
“我反对！”
王澶的眼神瞬间变得冰冷，嘴角勾起一抹残忍的笑容。
“既然你反对，那就给我去死吧！”
话音未落，王澶抬手便是一掌拍出。
元婴境的灵力凝聚成一只巨大的手掌，带着磅礴的天地之力，朝着五长老狠狠拍去。
掌风呼啸，空气被撕裂，周围的空间都泛起了细微的涟漪。
五长老脸色大变，连忙运转全身灵力，凝聚出一道护体灵光。
可他的修为不过是金丹一重，在元婴境的绝对实力面前，根本不堪一击。
巨大的手掌瞬间拍碎了五长老的护体灵光，重重地拍在他的胸口。

五长老喷出一口鲜血，身体如同断线的风筝般飞出去。
他重重地撞在石壁上，发出一声沉闷的巨响，而后滑落在地，抽搐了两下便没了气息。
现场瞬间陷入了死一般的寂静。
众人都没有想到，王澶竟然会说杀就杀，连一丝情面都不留。
“顺我者昌，逆我者亡！”王澶的声音回荡在院中，“还有谁反对？”
没有人敢说话，几位长老纷纷低下头，现在反抗，只有死路一条。
王澶满意地看着众人的反应，目光再次落在子书禾身上。
他早就看上了子书禾的极阴灵体，那可是天生的绝世炉鼎，若是能够与她双修，他的修为定然能够更进一步。
“子书禾，楚枫杀了我儿，老夫定要将此子碎尸万段，挫骨扬灰。
至于你，若是现在跪下，爬到老夫面前来，老夫还可以留你一命，让你做我的炉鼎。”
就算要杀子书禾，他也要先将她的极阴灵体彻底榨干。
“你休想！”
子书禾脸色铁青，浑身气得发抖。
“王澶，你可是我夫君的亲叔叔，你做出这种禽兽不如的事情，对得起他的在天之灵吗？”
“哈哈哈……”
王澶仰天大笑起来，笑声中充满了狂妄。
“王云山那个废物，也配谈在天之灵？
实话告诉你，王云山就是我杀的！”
“什么！”
这句话如同惊雷般炸响，在场的所有人都惊呆了。

几位长老更是猛地抬起头，眼神中充满了震惊之色。
子书禾浑身一颤，她难以置信地看着王澶，声音带着一丝颤抖。
“我夫君他……他真的是你杀的？”
王澶脸上满是狰狞之色，语气之中带着一丝不甘。
“我的修为远在他之上，凭什么他能做青山城城主？
若不是仗着那只天煞鬼虎，他算什么东西？”
“你这个畜生！”
子书禾目眦欲裂，她想要冲上去与王澶拼命，却被一股强大的威压死死按住，动弹不得。
王澶爆发出来的元婴境威压，如同山岳般将她镇压，让她连抬手的力气都没有。
几位长老也被这股威压逼得跪倒在地，脸色苍白，呼吸困难。
王澶一步步走到子书禾面前，眼中的贪婪愈发浓郁。
他抬手，用手指轻轻挑起了子书禾的下巴，感受着指尖细腻滑嫩的触感，嘴角勾起一抹猥琐的笑容。
“这么水灵的身子，老夫怎么忍心让你守寡？”
子书禾死死地瞪着王澶，牙齿咬得咯咯作响。
就在这时，一道凌厉的剑气突然从地牢之中飞出，剑气纵横刺向王澶！
“嗯？”
王澶脸色一变，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
他没想到地牢之中竟然还藏着人，而且剑气如此凌厉。
他不敢大意，身形瞬间向后滑行数丈，同时反手一掌拍出，一道浑厚的灵力匹练轰向那道剑气。
剑气与灵力匹练剧烈碰撞，发出一声震耳欲聋的巨响，星辞剑倒飞而回。

王澶眼神冰冷地盯着地牢大门，元婴境的神识瞬间扩散开来。
“谁？滚出来！”
话音刚落，一道修长的身影从地牢之中缓缓走了出来。
“她是我的女人。”
content_en:
It was a white-haired old man, wearing a green robe embroidered with Tai Chi patterns. He had a ruddy face and deep eyes, and his whole body exuded a faint power of Nascent Soul.
Wang Chan felt the unprecedented power in his body, and he couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth, throwing his head back and laughing.
Hahaha...
"I am done. From today on, I, Wang Chan, am the king of Qingshan City!"
The skylight poured in from outside the door, but it also illuminated the scene in the courtyard clearly.
Wang Tianfu was lying motionless on the ground, lifeless.
Wang Chan's pupils shrank suddenly and his breathing stopped.
He staggered a step, his outstretched fingers trembling slightly.
"W-what's going on..."
His throat rolled, and he raised his breath suddenly, his roar causing dust to fall from the beams.
"Who killed Tianfu!"
Wang Ying, who had been kneeling in the courtyard for a long time, was in tears at this moment.
"Grandpa, Chu Feng destroyed the entire Zhao family, and he even teamed up with that bitch Zi Shuhe to sneak into the house and attack and kill his father last night.
You must make the decision for your granddaughter and avenge your father! "
"What-"
Wang Chan's beard and hair were all spread out, and his old face was twisted with anger.
"What a couple of dogs. If I, the king, don't chop you into pieces and feed them to dogs to pay homage to my son's spirit in heaven, I will never be a human being!"
At this moment, Wang Tianshou, who had been standing by his side with his head bowed, took a step forward.
"Father, someone just saw Chu Feng and Zi Shuhe heading towards the dungeon where the family keeps monster beasts."
Wang Chan turned his head suddenly and looked towards the direction of the dungeon with his red eyes.
"Follow me to the dungeon!"
Outside the dungeon, several old men were surrounding Zi Shuhe, persuading him earnestly.
"Keep the green hills here and don't worry about running out of firewood. You'd better leave the City Lord's Mansion first and avoid the limelight for a while."
"Yes, as long as you break through to the Nascent Soul Realm in the future, you will naturally be able to take back the position of City Lord."
"Wang Chan is furious now. We can't stop him at all. If you don't leave, it will be too late!"
They were all loyal to the city lord Wang Yunshan. After learning from Zi Shuhe why Wang Tianfu died, they immediately panicked.
Now that Wang Chan has broken through to the Nascent Soul Realm, even if they go together, there is absolutely no way they can be Wang Chan's opponent.
Zi Shuhe stood there, his eyes falling on the dungeon door, with mixed feelings in his heart.
Originally, she did not believe that Chu Feng could tame the Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger, but at this moment, a glimmer of hope arose in her heart.
Maybe, he really can do it.
Thinking of this, Zi Shuhe slowly shook his head and said firmly.
"I won't leave."
"What?"
Several elders were shocked, with puzzled expressions on their faces.
"Wang Chan is coming soon, he won't let you go!"
Zi Shuhe did not explain, but held the City Lord's Order tightly in his hand, his eyes still fixed on the dungeon door.
She didn't know why she chose to believe Chu Feng, but she just had a feeling in her heart.
If you run away today, you will never come back.
At this moment, there was a rush of footsteps in the distance.
Everyone turned around and saw Wang Chan leading a large number of Wang family's children and elders, charging over with murderous intent.
"No one can leave today!"
Wang Chan stopped, his cold eyes swept over everyone present, and finally landed on Zi Shuhe.
"Where is Chu Feng, where is he hiding?"
Zi Shuhe clenched the City Lord's Order in his hand, took a step forward and said coldly.
"Wang Chan, what do you want to do?"
Wang Chan sneered, his eyes full of disdain.
"I have broken through to the Nascent Soul Realm. Looking at the entire Qingshan City, no one is my opponent.
Do you think you can still command me with a broken token? "
His eyes swept over the elders guarding Zi Shuhe, and his tone contained a hint of threat.
"From now on, I will be the city lord. Who is in favor and who is against?"
The expressions of several elders changed. At this moment, the fifth elder stood up.
"I object!"
Wang Chan's eyesGod instantly became cold, and a cruel smile appeared on the corner of his mouth.
"Since you object, then go to hell!"
Before he finished speaking, Wang Chan raised his hand and slapped it with his palm.
The spiritual power of the Nascent Soul realm condensed into a huge palm, and with the majestic power of heaven and earth, it struck hard at the fifth elder.
The wind roared in the palm, the air was torn apart, and subtle ripples appeared in the surrounding space.
The fifth elder's expression changed drastically, and he quickly used all his spiritual power to condense a body-protecting spiritual light.
But his cultivation is only at the first level of the Golden Core, and he is completely vulnerable to the absolute strength of the Nascent Soul Realm.
The huge palm instantly shattered the fifth elder's protective aura and slapped him hard on the chest.
The fifth elder spat out a mouthful of blood, and his body flew out like a kite with its string broken.
He hit the stone wall heavily, making a dull loud noise, and then slipped to the ground, twitched twice and then lost his breath.
The scene instantly fell into deathly silence.
No one expected that Wang Chan would kill at will without even showing any mercy.
"Those who follow me will prosper, and those who go against me will perish!" Wang Chan's voice echoed in the courtyard, "Who else is against it?"
No one dared to speak, and several elders lowered their heads. If they resist now, they will only die.
Wang Chan watched everyone's reactions with satisfaction, and his eyes fell on Zi Shuhe again.
He has long been interested in Zi Shuhe's extremely yin spirit body, which is a natural and peerless furnace. If he can cultivate with her, his cultivation will definitely be further improved.
"Zi Shuhe, if Chu Feng kills my son, I will definitely cut his body into thousands of pieces and crush his bones into ashes.
As for you, if you kneel down and crawl in front of me now, I can spare your life and let you be my cauldron. "
Even if he wants to kill Zi Shuhe, he must first drain her extremely yin spirit body completely.
"Don't even think about it!"
Zi Shuhe's face was ashen and his whole body was shaking with anger.
"Wang Chan, you are my husband's biological uncle. Are you worthy of his spirit in heaven if you do something worse than a beast?"
"Hahaha..."
Wang Chan looked up to the sky and laughed, his laughter full of arrogance.
"Is that good-for-nothing Wang Yunshan worthy of talking about the spirit in heaven?
To tell you the truth, I was the one who killed Wang Yunshan! "
"What!"
These words exploded like thunder, and everyone present was stunned.
Several elders raised their heads suddenly, their eyes filled with shock.
Zi Shuhe trembled all over. She looked at Wang Chan in disbelief, her voice trembling.
"My husband... was it really you who killed him?"
Wang Chan's face was full of ferocious expression, and there was a trace of unwillingness in his tone.
"My cultivation level is far above his, why should he be the lord of Qingshan City?
If it weren't for that evil ghost tiger, who would he be? "
"You beast!"
Zi Shuhe's eyes were about to burst. She wanted to rush forward and fight Wang Chan, but she was held down by a strong pressure and could not move.
The Nascent Soul realm pressure that Wang Chan unleashed suppressed her like a mountain, leaving her unable to even raise her hands.
Several elders were also forced to kneel to the ground by this coercion, their faces were pale and they had difficulty breathing.
Wang Chan walked up to Zi Shuhe step by step, the greed in his eyes becoming more intense.
He raised his hand and gently lifted Zi Shuhe's chin with his fingers, feeling the delicate and smooth touch of his fingertips, and a lewd smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"With such a graceful body, how can I bear to make you a widow?"
Zi Shuhe glared at Wang Chan, his teeth chattering.
At this moment, a sharp sword energy suddenly flew out from the dungeon, and the sword energy stabbed Wang Chan vertically and horizontally!
"Huh?"
Wang Chan's expression changed, and a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
He didn't expect that there was someone hiding in the dungeon, and that the sword energy was so powerful.
He did not dare to be careless, and instantly slid back a few feet. At the same time, he slapped a palm with his backhand, and a strong spiritual force blasted towards the sword energy.
Sword energy and spiritual power collide violently, with a deafening sound, the Xingci Sword flew back.
Wang Chan stared at the dungeon door with cold eyes, and his consciousness at the Nascent Soul realm spread instantly.
"Who? Get out!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a slender figure slowly walked out of the dungeon.
"She is my woman."
